cp.faq.title: Commission <red>questions</red>
cp.faq.sub: How the plan works, in plain words.
cp.faq.1.q: What do I earn as a TradeQuo partner?
cp.faq.1.a: A commission on every lot your referred clients trade, worth up to 87% of the spread. If you build a network, you also earn on the partners you bring in.
cp.faq.2.a: Up to 87% of the spread on every lot your referred clients trade. Use the calculator above for an estimate.
cp.faq.3.a: Every day. Commissions settle at 00:00 server time, and we cover processing and withdrawal fees.
cp.faq.4.q: How does the spread-based commission work?
cp.faq.4.a: TradeQuo earns from the spread on each trade. You receive a share of it — up to 87% — on every lot your referred clients trade, for as long as they stay active.
cp.faq.5.q: Is there a limit on what I can earn?
cp.faq.5.a: No. There’s no cap on the number of clients you refer or the volume they trade.
cp.faq.6.q: Where can I get more details?
cp.faq.6.a: Send a partner request and your dedicated partner manager will walk you through the plan. We review every application within 24 hours.
